utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sorry, I got distracted again—so Quinn's doing a repair drive this weekend? What exactly are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, it's for the community center's old benches and playground equipment—Quinn's organizing the whole thing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the benches—okay, I think I can help with that. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Dane, the repair drive is this Saturday. I'm helping out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, great! I was worried I'd missed the planning. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think it's at 10, but I should double-check with Ira—they've got the flyer details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Absolutely serious, but I'm still worried about how we'll move everything if Vik's truck isn't enough.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you're telling me we need more than Vik's truck? How much stuff are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Tess—what's up with the repair drive again? I'm a bit fuzzy on the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it's this weekend! We're helping folks fix up their stuff, and Faye's worried about school pickup times clashing. Still game?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, still game. Just tell me what slot you need me for, and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ira, about the flyers — did you want to hand them out together, or were you planning to drop them off at the shops?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm happy to hand them out together! Let's meet at the corner store later.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sounds good! What time works for you to meet there?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh Gus, do you know when the repair drive is? I keep forgetting if it's this Saturday or next.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's this Saturday for sure! I'm planning to be there bright and early with my truck full of tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's a relief to know—I'll finally mark it on my calendar right now and see if I can scrounge up something useful to bring.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey, glad you're on board! I've got a list right here—the old playground, Mrs. Henderson's fence, and the community garden shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve already mapped out the quickest route to hit all three spots, starting with the shed since its tools are needed for the fence.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, you're a lifesaver with that route! I'll spread the word to everyone to meet at the shed first thing Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Uli, just a heads-up—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I heard you'll be there early to help set up, and I'm so grateful for that!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks for the update, Rosa. I'll still come early, but I'm afraid I won't be as useful as before.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Don't worry, Uli—your help setting up is just as valuable no matter what day it is. We'll get it all sorted together!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I'll have the truck ready Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring my drill and some spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's set a time—I like to have things squared away ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm already planning to bring my old lawnmower. Need a hand setting up tables or anything beforehand?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh great, I was just telling Noah about it—I'll text him the details later today. Tables would be awesome, maybe we can grab Leo to help too!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Cleo, just a heads-up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. I hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks for the heads-up, Mara! I already heard from Rosa, but I'll be there Sunday with my spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'm glad you're still on board—those spare parts will definitely come in handy!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mina, I'm glad you asked! We're fixing up old bikes for the kids in the neighborhood — Gus is grabbing some tools from his shed, and Hana's on board to help Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what time are you all starting on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We're starting at 9 AM sharp — figured we'd get an early start before it gets too hot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I'm still a bit fuzzy on the details—could I see that list of locations? Maybe that'll jog my memory.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure, I've got the list right here. Faye was worried about the times clashing with school pickup, so take a look and see if we can work around that.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, school pickup—yeah, that's a good point. Let me see that list; I'll try to spot any conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Ira! The repair drive—right, that's the thing with the tools, isn't it? I keep forgetting if it's this Saturday or next.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Next Saturday, I think—Dane mentioned it when I offered to hand out flyers. You need a reminder?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Next Saturday? Good, good—I'll write it on my hand this time. Thanks, Ira—you're a lifesaver!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Pia, you're not going to believe it—this repair drive is really taking off! I've already got a great team together for this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's wonderful news, Quinn, but I have to ask—do we have enough vehicle space confirmed for all the tools and materials, or are we going to run into bottlenecks?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, good point! I've got Sam bringing his truck, and I think Hana can squeeze in some stuff too. We should be fine, but let me double-check with them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! So glad you're here. Just a quick heads-up—the repair drive got rescheduled to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely serious! It's going to be this Sunday at the community center, and we'd love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I think it's this Saturday... Ira offered to help with flyers, so that's one thing sorted.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, perfect! So it's definitely this Saturday at the community center, 10 to 4—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Right, I remember now—10 to 4. Thanks for confirming, Vik. I'll remind Ira about the flyers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Quinn's organizing a repair drive this weekend. I've got the list of locations if you want to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the plan for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Quinn's got us hitting the park bench, the community center steps, and the old fence along Maple Lane. I've got the order mapped out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Bo, I just want to double-check—are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday? I want to make sure the tool list is accurate before Sam and Noah arrive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, Saturday's good. Just tell me what tools you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Bo. I think we need a few specific items: a set of screwdrivers, a cordless drill, and a multimeter. Can you bring those?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Mara, sorry I'm late. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, no problem! Quick update: the drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh perfect, Sunday works way better for me. I can help set up in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Uli, thanks for meeting me about the repair drive. I need to sort out the school pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Faye. I'll be there early, but I might have to step away for a bit... something came up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No problem, Uli. Just let me know when you need to step away so I can adjust the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Jules, I'm definitely in for the repair drive—I've got that old lawnmower ready to go, and I can lend a hand with setup if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Sam! That lawnmower will be a lifesaver. Let me grab that tool from Gus's shed, and then we can get everything set up early.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Need any help hauling that tool from Gus's shed? I can give you a hand.
